documents.text: Vacation policy. Every employee receives 30 vacation days per year. Unused vacation days expire at the end of March of the following year.
Security policy. Production passwords must be rotated every 90 days. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for all administrator accounts.
Deployment guide. Astra is deployed with Docker Compose. The API container waits for a healthy PostgreSQL database before it starts serving traffic.
Expense policy. Travel expenses above 500 euros need approval from a manager before the trip is booked.
On-call handbook. The on-call engineer must acknowledge every production alert within 15 minutes and write an incident note.
